content.text:
The evidence has two ledgers that conflict: Tenant 3 says Harbor Printing is largest (3,600), while Tenant 4 says Delta Cleaning is largest (5,200) after the audit correction.

The two ledgers belong to different tenants, so they may not describe the same set of invoices. The question doesn't name a tenant. The Tenant 4 note explicitly reflects an audit correction, which suggests it is the more up-to-date figure. It also gives Delta Cleaning 5,200 against Tenant 3's 3,000, so the Delta figures differ between the ledgers. This supports the idea that the Tenant 4 note supersedes the earlier figures.

Choosing the corrected, later-looking figure gives Delta Cleaning.

**A**
